notes.title: Rework in progress
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just want to drop by this message. I have been very busy - but still manage to squeeze hours for the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859605/1855d20c47cf31a06ed02458fe90254c14974a0a.png


So basically, I'm rewriting the game. I'm not personally satisfied how it turned out.
Im working on a update of following:
- switching to a game engine: this is a big one. decided to leave my custom game engine for a full featured game engine. this will take some time, but I'm progressing in a quite good pace
- simplified game logic: the game will be more simple to play, but the challenges will remain
- custom beer recipes: I'm implementing the change for everyone to be able to design its own beer.
beer will be able to be designed and sold to market
- pipes! yes piping to connect the machines should be in place. no more only workers will carry the materials inside factory. after all we are beer brewing business.
- graphics improvements
- many quality of life bugfixes: so you wont be bothered with resolution change etc!

stay tuned, and please drop me a message anytime!
